core_cards: Skirk Prospector; Goblin Matron; Mogg War Marshal; Gempalm Incinerator; Dralnu's Crusade; Empty the Warrens; Cryptic Gateway; Urza's Incubator; Goblin Turncoat; Festering Goblin; Deadapult; Sulfuric Vortex; Goblin Medics; Subterranean Scout
rationale: Pashalik Mons turns every Goblin death into damage and Skirk Prospector turns them into mana; Dralnu's Crusade ("All Goblins are black and are Zombies") lets Deadapult ("Sacrifice a Zombie: ...deals 2 damage") eat any Goblin, while Urza's Incubator and Cryptic Gateway cheat expensive Goblins like Siege-Gang Commander into play; Sulfuric Vortex is the cross-tag reach finisher that also shuts off opposing lifegain.
pitch: A relentless red swarm where dying Goblins are a resource, not a loss. Skirk Prospector sacrifices them for mana and Pashalik Mons turns each death into damage, while Siege-Gang Commander and Sulfuric Vortex push the last points through. Pick this if you love flooding the board and attacking without mercy.
pitch_es: Una horda roja implacable donde los Goblins que mueren son un recurso, no una pérdida. Skirk Prospector los sacrifica para hacer maná y Pashalik Mons convierte cada muerte en daño, mientras Siege-Gang Commander y Sulfuric Vortex empujan los últimos puntos. Elige esto si te encanta inundar el campo y atacar sin piedad.
rationale_es: Pashalik Mons convierte cada muerte de Goblin en daño y Skirk Prospector los convierte en maná; Dralnu's Crusade ("All Goblins are black and are Zombies") permite a Deadapult ("Sacrifice a Zombie: ...deals 2 damage") devorar cualquier Goblin, mientras Urza's Incubator y Cryptic Gateway hacen trampa con Goblins caros como Siege-Gang Commander; Sulfuric Vortex es el finalizador de alcance entre etiquetas que además apaga la ganancia de vida rival.

core_cards: Phyrexian Ghoul; Phyrexian Debaser; Zombie Infestation; Mogg War Marshal; Symbiotic Beast; Penumbra Bobcat; Necrosavant; Pyre Zombie; Dread Return; Gamekeeper; Mindslicer; Lieutenant Kirtar; Urborg Syphon-Mage; Spinal Embrace; Siege-Gang Commander; Skirk Prospector
rationale: Yawgmoth converts spare bodies into cards plus -1/-1 removal while Oversold Cemetery ("if you have four or more creature cards in your graveyard... return target creature card... to your hand") rebuys the fodder; cross-tag: Spinal Embrace steals a blocker you can feed to Phyrexian Ghoul before its own end-step sacrifice, and Mindslicer's death dumps hands when yours is already empty.
pitch: Every creature you control is fuel for something better. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician turns them into cards and shrinking blockers while Oversold Cemetery keeps handing the fodder back, so the long attrition war is never close. For players who enjoy squeezing advantage out of every death.
pitch_es: Cada criatura que controlas es combustible para algo mejor. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician las convierte en cartas y en bloqueadores encogidos, mientras Oversold Cemetery te devuelve el forraje una y otra vez, así que la guerra de desgaste nunca está reñida. Para quienes disfrutan exprimiendo ventaja de cada muerte.
rationale_es: Yawgmoth convierte cuerpos sobrantes en cartas y en eliminación con contadores -1/-1, mientras Oversold Cemetery ("if you have four or more creature cards in your graveyard... return target creature card... to your hand") recupera el forraje; entre etiquetas: Spinal Embrace roba un bloqueador que puedes dar de comer a Phyrexian Ghoul antes del sacrificio de su propio paso final, y la muerte de Mindslicer vacía manos cuando la tuya ya está vacía.

core_cards: Mystic Enforcer; Werebear; Nantuko Monastery; Terravore; Glory; Vigilant Sentry; Mystic Zealot; Nomad Decoy; Krosan Restorer; Battlefield Scrounger; Seton's Desire; Nut Collector; Frantic Search; Millikin; Street Wraith; Fa'adiyah Seer; Entomb
rationale: Divine Sacrament, Mystic Enforcer, Werebear, Nantuko Monastery and friends all upgrade once "there are seven or more cards in your graveyard", and the cube's 20+ cycling cards plus Frantic Search/Millikin/Street Wraith fill the yard while replacing themselves; Glory grants color protection while sitting in the graveyard.
pitch: Seven cards in the graveyard and the whole deck levels up. Cheap self-mill and cycling switch on Mystic Enforcer and Werebear well ahead of schedule, and Glory shields the team from the yard you just filled. Rewarding if you like decks that quietly power up and then take over.
pitch_es: Siete cartas en el cementerio y todo el mazo sube de nivel. El automill barato y el cycling activan a Mystic Enforcer y Werebear mucho antes de tiempo, y Glory protege a tu equipo desde el cementerio que acabas de llenar. Gratificante si te gustan los mazos que se cargan en silencio y luego toman el control.
rationale_es: Divine Sacrament, Mystic Enforcer, Werebear, Nantuko Monastery y compañía mejoran en cuanto "there are seven or more cards in your graveyard", y las más de 20 cartas con cycling del cubo, junto a Frantic Search/Millikin/Street Wraith, llenan el cementerio mientras se reemplazan solas; Glory otorga protección de color desde el propio cementerio.
key_themes_es: Cementerio; Automill; Delirium; Lanzar desde el cementerio

core_cards: Sylvan Library; Enlightened Tutor; Auramancer; Sevinne's Reclamation; Mystic Remora; Hunting Grounds; Squirrel Nest; Divine Sacrament; Wild Growth; Seton's Desire; Veiled Serpent
rationale: Mesa Enchantress draws a card per enchantment cast and Zur the Enchanter puts any enchantment "with mana value 3 or less" straight onto the battlefield — Mystic Remora (1), Hunting Grounds (2), Sylvan Library (2), Divine Sacrament (3), Squirrel Nest (3); Sevinne's Reclamation and Auramancer rebuy them from the graveyard.
pitch: Cast an enchantment, draw a card, repeat until the game is over. Mesa Enchantress and Zur the Enchanter bury opponents in card advantage while Sylvan Library and Mystic Remora keep your hand full. For players who want to build a machine and win on sheer resources.
pitch_es: Lanza un encantamiento, roba una carta, repite hasta que la partida termine. Mesa Enchantress y Zur the Enchanter entierran al rival en ventaja de cartas mientras Sylvan Library y Mystic Remora mantienen tu mano llena. Para quienes quieren construir una máquina y ganar por puros recursos.
rationale_es: Mesa Enchantress roba una carta por cada encantamiento lanzado y Zur the Enchanter pone cualquier encantamiento "with mana value 3 or less" directamente en el campo de batalla — Mystic Remora (1), Hunting Grounds (2), Sylvan Library (2), Divine Sacrament (3), Squirrel Nest (3); Sevinne's Reclamation y Auramancer los recuperan del cementerio.

core_cards: Battle Screech; Call of the Herd; Squirrel Nest; Nut Collector; Symbiotic Beast; Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse; Empty the Warrens; Mogg War Marshal; Kavu Primarch; Congregate; Divine Sacrament; Rith, the Awakener; Siege-Gang Commander
rationale: Opposition converts token width into a full tap-down lock; Saproling Symbiosis, Battle Screech, and Squirrel Nest go wide while Divine Sacrament pumps the white tokens, Congregate ("2 life for each creature") and Kavu Primarch's convoke cash the width in, and Nut Collector's threshold makes every Squirrel a 3/3.
pitch: One creature at a time was never the plan. Saproling Symbiosis and Battle Screech flood the board, Divine Sacrament makes the whole team lethal, and Opposition can tap the opponent out of the game entirely. Perfect if you like big boards and swinging with everything.
pitch_es: Ir de una criatura en una criatura nunca fue el plan. Saproling Symbiosis y Battle Screech inundan el campo, Divine Sacrament vuelve letal a todo el equipo y Opposition puede dejar al rival girado fuera de la partida. Perfecto si te gustan los tableros enormes y atacar con todo.
rationale_es: Opposition convierte la anchura de fichas en un bloqueo total por giro; Saproling Symbiosis, Battle Screech y Squirrel Nest van a lo ancho mientras Divine Sacrament pompea las fichas blancas, Congregate ("2 life for each creature") y el convoke de Kavu Primarch cobran esa anchura, y el threshold de Nut Collector convierte a cada Ardilla en un 3/3.

core_cards: Entomb; Body Snatcher; Dread Return; Life // Death; Worldgorger Dragon; Gamble; Vampiric Tutor; Worldly Tutor; Gamekeeper; Zombie Infestation; Frantic Search; Denizen of the Deep; Arcanis the Omnipotent; Phantom Nishoba; Shivan Dragon
rationale: Entomb and Gamble (tutor plus random discard) stock the graveyard; Chainer, Dread Return, and Life // Death return the bodies while Sneak Attack cheats them in from hand; cross-tag: Worldly Tutor + Gamekeeper ("reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield") cheats any creature from the library, and Arcanis, Denizen of the Deep, and Phantom Nishoba are untagged but textbook targets (huge bodies or a repeatable "{T}: Draw three cards").
pitch: Skip the mana cost and drop something game-ending far too early. Entomb and Gamble load the graveyard, then Chainer and Dread Return haul the monsters back while Sneak Attack slams them straight from hand. For players who want explosive, do-something-huge turns.
pitch_es: Sáltate el coste de maná y suelta algo que acaba partidas muchísimo antes de tiempo. Entomb y Gamble cargan el cementerio, luego Chainer y Dread Return traen de vuelta a los monstruos mientras Sneak Attack los planta directamente desde la mano. Para quienes quieren turnos explosivos en los que pasa algo enorme.
rationale_es: Entomb y Gamble (tutor más descarte aleatorio) llenan el cementerio; Chainer, Dread Return y Life // Death devuelven los cuerpos mientras Sneak Attack hace trampa desde la mano; entre etiquetas: Worldly Tutor + Gamekeeper ("reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card onto the battlefield") saca cualquier criatura de la biblioteca, y Arcanis, Denizen of the Deep y Phantom Nishoba no están etiquetados pero son objetivos de manual (cuerpos enormes o un "{T}: Draw three cards" repetible).

core_cards: Obsessive Search; Dark Withering; Ichor Slick; Aquamoeba; Zombie Infestation; Jalum Tome; Undead Gladiator; Urborg Syphon-Mage; Frantic Search; Mindslicer; Gamble
rationale: The four madness cards turn every discard outlet (Aquamoeba, Zombie Infestation, Jalum Tome, Vexing Sphinx's cumulative upkeep) into mana-discounted spells and Zombie tokens; a Mindslicer hand-dump is asymmetric when half your hand casts itself from exile.
pitch: Throwing cards away is how this deck pays for things. Discard outlets like Aquamoeba and Zombie Infestation cast your madness spells at a discount, turning the bin into a weapon. Great for players who enjoy clever, cost-cutting sequencing.
pitch_es: Tirar cartas es la forma en que este mazo paga sus cosas. Los medios de descarte como Aquamoeba y Zombie Infestation lanzan tus cartas con madness con descuento y convierten el cementerio en un arma. Genial para quienes disfrutan de una secuenciación ingeniosa que recorta costes.
rationale_es: Las cuatro cartas con madness convierten cada medio de descarte (Aquamoeba, Zombie Infestation, Jalum Tome, el coste de mantenimiento acumulativo de Vexing Sphinx) en hechizos con descuento de maná y en fichas de Zombie; el vaciado de manos de Mindslicer es asimétrico cuando media mano tuya se lanza sola desde el exilio.
key_themes_es: Cementerio; Wheels; Lanzar desde el cementerio

core_cards: Renewed Faith; Radiant's Judgment; Solar Blast; Slice and Dice; Spark Spray; Gempalm Incinerator; Lull; Break Asunder; Primal Boost; Macetail Hystrodon; Street Wraith; Undead Gladiator; Cloud of Faeries; Ichor Slick; Improvised Armor; Drifting Meadow; Remote Isle; Polluted Mire; Smoldering Crater; Slippery Karst; Elvish Aberration; Wild Dogs; Veiled Serpent; Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse; Grim Lavamancer
key_themes: Engine/Outlet payoffs on the cycling keyword; Graveyard cross-over
rationale: Lightning Rift and Invigorating Boon both trigger "whenever a player cycles a card" and the cube holds 20+ cyclers including five cycling lands; the same cycling doubles as Threshold fuel, cross-tag Jolrael converts each cycle draw into her "second card each turn" Cat trigger, and Grim Lavamancer ("Exile two cards from your graveyard") burns the spent cyclers.
pitch: A deck that never floods, because every dead card becomes a new one. Lightning Rift and Invigorating Boon turn each cycled card into free damage or growth, so there is always something to do. Ideal if you like consistency and steady incremental value.
pitch_es: Un mazo que nunca se inunda, porque cada carta muerta se convierte en una nueva. Lightning Rift e Invigorating Boon transforman cada carta ciclada en daño gratis o en crecimiento, así que siempre tienes algo que hacer. Ideal si te gusta la consistencia y el valor constante y acumulativo.
rationale_es: Lightning Rift e Invigorating Boon se activan "whenever a player cycles a card" y el cubo tiene más de 20 cicladores, incluidas cinco tierras con cycling; ese mismo cycling sirve de combustible para Threshold, entre etiquetas Jolrael convierte cada robo por ciclo en su disparo de Gato de "segunda carta cada turno", y Grim Lavamancer ("Exile two cards from your graveyard") quema los cicladores ya gastados.
key_themes_es: Recompensas de motor sobre la palabra clave cycling; cruce con Cementerio

core_cards: Empty the Warrens; Storm Entity; Helm of Awakening; Turnabout; Snap; Frantic Search; Cloud of Faeries; Peregrine Drake; Lotus Blossom; Coal Stoker; Elvish Spirit Guide; Mystical Tutor; Overmaster; Stroke of Genius; Time Stretch; Last Chance; Force of Will, Deep Analysis
rationale: High Tide plus the free-untap suite (Turnabout, Frantic Search, Snap, Cloud of Faeries, Peregrine Drake) generates mana and storm count, Helm of Awakening discounts every spell, and Grapeshot / Empty the Warrens / Stroke of Genius convert the turn into a kill; Force of Will's alternative cost protects the combo turn while adding to storm, and Last Chance / Time Stretch buy the extra turn to finish.
pitch: One enormous turn, assembled out of almost nothing. High Tide and free untappers build a mountain of mana, then Grapeshot or Empty the Warrens converts it into a kill. For players who love chaining spells toward a lethal finish.
pitch_es: Un turno descomunal, montado casi desde la nada. High Tide y los desgiradores gratuitos construyen una montaña de maná, y luego Grapeshot o Empty the Warrens la convierten en una victoria. Para quienes adoran encadenar hechizos hacia un final letal.
rationale_es: High Tide más el paquete de desgiro gratuito (Turnabout, Frantic Search, Snap, Cloud of Faeries, Peregrine Drake) genera maná y cuenta de storm, Helm of Awakening abarata cada hechizo, y Grapeshot / Empty the Warrens / Stroke of Genius convierten el turno en una victoria; el coste alternativo de Force of Will protege el turno de combo mientras suma a la tormenta, y Last Chance / Time Stretch compran el turno extra para rematar.

core_cards: Whitemane Lion; Sawtooth Loon; Man-o'-War; Flametongue Kavu; Peregrine Drake; Cloud of Faeries; Faceless Butcher; Wormfang Drake; Umbilicus; Body Snatcher; Cackling Fiend; Phyrexian Rager; Sun Clasp
rationale: Momentary Blink, Whitemane Lion, and Sun Clasp rebuy enter-the-battlefield triggers (Flametongue Kavu, Man-o'-War, Phyrexian Rager, Deadwood Treefolk's "enters or leaves the battlefield" recursion); cross-tag Umbilicus — its upkeep bounce ("they return a permanent they control to its owner's hand") is pure upside when your permanents want to re-enter.
pitch: Good enter-the-battlefield triggers are far too good to use only once. Momentary Blink and Whitemane Lion re-trigger Flametongue Kavu and Man-o'-War until the opponent has nothing left. Satisfying if you like value engines and an answer for everything.
pitch_es: Los buenos disparos de entrada al campo de batalla son demasiado buenos para usarlos una sola vez. Momentary Blink y Whitemane Lion vuelven a disparar a Flametongue Kavu y Man-o'-War hasta que al rival no le queda nada. Satisfactorio si te gustan los motores de valor y tener respuesta para todo.
rationale_es: Momentary Blink, Whitemane Lion y Sun Clasp recuperan disparos de entrada al campo de batalla (Flametongue Kavu, Man-o'-War, Phyrexian Rager, la recursión de Deadwood Treefolk de "enters or leaves the battlefield"); entre etiquetas Umbilicus — su rebote en el mantenimiento ("they return a permanent they control to its owner's hand") es pura ventaja cuando tus permanentes quieren volver a entrar.

core_cards: Windborn Muse; Crawlspace; Arboria; Maze of Ith; Icy Manipulator; Royal Assassin; Nomad Decoy; Mystic Remora; Damping Sphere; Umbilicus; Wrath of God; Absorb; Jester's Cap; Wall of Junk; Floodgate
rationale: No Mercy, Windborn Muse, Crawlspace, and Arboria make attacking miserable while Icy Manipulator and Nomad Decoy tap threats for cross-tag Royal Assassin ("Destroy target tapped creature"); Mystic Remora draws through it, Wrath of God resets, and Jester's Cap strips the opponent's win conditions in the attrition endgame.
pitch: A deck built to make attacking you a bad idea. No Mercy and Windborn Muse punish aggression, Icy Manipulator taps whatever is left, and Wrath of God resets anything that slips through. For players who enjoy saying no and winning slowly.
pitch_es: Un mazo construido para que atacarte sea una mala idea. No Mercy y Windborn Muse castigan la agresión, Icy Manipulator gira lo que quede y Wrath of God reinicia lo que se cuele. Para quienes disfrutan diciendo que no y ganando despacio.
rationale_es: No Mercy, Windborn Muse, Crawlspace y Arboria hacen miserable atacar mientras Icy Manipulator y Nomad Decoy giran amenazas para el Royal Assassin de cruce ("Destroy target tapped creature"); Mystic Remora roba a través de todo ello, Wrath of God reinicia, y Jester's Cap arranca las condiciones de victoria del rival en el final de desgaste.

core_cards: Urza's Blueprints; Triskelion; Mishra's Factory; Mind Stone; Millikin; Jalum Tome; Lotus Blossom; Helm of Awakening; Icy Manipulator; Juggernaut; Dragon Engine; Ornithopter; Wall of Junk; Dodecapod; Legacy Weapon; Enlightened Tutor
rationale: Urza's Construct token "gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control" and "Tap an untapped artifact you control: Add {U}" turns Mind Stone, Millikin, and even Ornithopter into mana; Urza's Blueprints' echo {6} is trivial with that mana, and Triskelion is the top-end sink Enlightened Tutor can find.
pitch: Trinkets that quietly add up to an engine. Urza, Lord High Artificer turns your artifacts into a giant Construct and a pile of mana, powering out payoffs like Triskelion. For players who like combo-adjacent value engines.
pitch_es: Cacharros que sin hacer ruido acaban siendo un motor. Urza, Lord High Artificer convierte tus artefactos en un Constructo gigante y en un montón de maná, con el que despliegas recompensas como Triskelion. Para quienes disfrutan de los motores de valor cercanos al combo.
rationale_es: La ficha de Constructo de Urza "gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control" y su "Tap an untapped artifact you control: Add {U}" convierten Mind Stone, Millikin e incluso Ornithopter en maná; el echo {6} de Urza's Blueprints es trivial con ese maná, y Triskelion es el sumidero de gama alta que Enlightened Tutor puede encontrar.

core_cards: Congregate; Lyra Dawnbringer; Spirit Link; Renewed Faith; Kjeldoran Gargoyle; Phantom Nishoba; Cleric of the Forward Order; Absorb; Gerrard's Verdict; Urborg Syphon-Mage; Sol'kanar the Swamp King
rationale: Test of Endurance wins the game at 50 or more life and Serra Avatar's "power and toughness are each equal to your life total"; Congregate, Lyra's lifelink aura, Spirit Link, and Kjeldoran Gargoyle do the gaining, with Sol'kanar taxing every black spell for extra life.
pitch: Gain enough life and it stops being defence. Congregate, Lyra Dawnbringer and Spirit Link push the total somewhere silly, then Test of Endurance and Serra Avatar cash it in. For players who like outlasting opponents and flipping defence into offence.
pitch_es: Gana suficiente vida y deja de ser defensa. Congregate, Lyra Dawnbringer y Spirit Link llevan el total a cifras absurdas, y luego Test of Endurance y Serra Avatar lo cobran. Para quienes disfrutan sobreviviendo al rival y convirtiendo la defensa en ataque.
rationale_es: Test of Endurance gana la partida con 50 vidas o más y Serra Avatar tiene "power and toughness are each equal to your life total"; Congregate, el aura de vínculo vital de Lyra, Spirit Link y Kjeldoran Gargoyle hacen la ganancia, con Sol'kanar cobrando impuesto a cada hechizo negro para dar vida extra.

core_cards: Terravore; Kamahl, Fist of Krosa; Krosan Restorer; Crop Rotation; Nature's Lore; Wild Growth; High Tide; Fa'adiyah Seer; Elvish Aberration; Squirrel Nest; Birds of Paradise
rationale: Exploration plus Tatyova turns every extra land drop into a card and a life; Terravore ("power and toughness are each equal to the number of land cards in all graveyards") feeds on the cube's cycling lands and Crop Rotation, while Kamahl and Squirrel Nest give flooded lands a job.
pitch: Every land drop should do something. Exploration and Tatyova, Benthic Druid turn extra lands into cards and life, while Terravore grows into a finisher off the graveyard. For players who enjoy accelerating ahead and grinding out value.
pitch_es: Cada tierra que juegas debería hacer algo. Exploration y Tatyova, Benthic Druid convierten las tierras extra en cartas y vida, mientras Terravore crece hasta ser un finalizador desde el cementerio. Para quienes disfrutan acelerando por delante y moliendo valor.
rationale_es: Exploration más Tatyova convierten cada tierra extra jugada en una carta y una vida; Terravore ("power and toughness are each equal to the number of land cards in all graveyards") se alimenta de las tierras con cycling del cubo y de Crop Rotation, mientras Kamahl y Squirrel Nest le dan trabajo a las tierras sobrantes.

core_cards: Dragon Blood; Invigorating Boon; Phantom Nishoba; Phantom Flock; Kavu Primarch; Spiritmonger; Phyrexian Scuta; Yawgmoth, Thran Physician
rationale: Forgotten Ancient soaks a counter per spell and each upkeep may "move any number of +1/+1 counters from this creature onto other creatures" — onto Triskelion for direct damage or onto Phantom Flock / Phantom Nishoba to recharge their damage-prevention shields; Yawgmoth's proliferate and Dragon Blood keep the counters flowing.
pitch: One creature, counters piling up, until it simply ends the game. Forgotten Ancient hoards them and hands them to Triskelion or the Phantoms, and proliferate keeps them coming. For players who like building a single unstoppable threat.
pitch_es: Una criatura, contadores acumulándose, hasta que sencillamente termina la partida. Forgotten Ancient los acapara y se los pasa a Triskelion o a los Phantoms, y proliferar los mantiene llegando. Para quienes disfrutan construyendo una única amenaza imparable.
rationale_es: Forgotten Ancient absorbe un contador por hechizo y en cada mantenimiento puede "move any number of +1/+1 counters from this creature onto other creatures" — a Triskelion para daño directo o a Phantom Flock / Phantom Nishoba para recargar sus escudos de prevención de daño; el proliferar de Yawgmoth y Dragon Blood mantienen el flujo de contadores.

core_cards: Crop Rotation; Exploration; Krosan Restorer; Vampiric Tutor
rationale: Dark Depths makes a legendary 20/20 flying indestructible token once its ten ice counters are gone; Crop Rotation ("Search your library for a land card, put that card onto the battlefield") fetches it, Exploration replays the land drops it eats, and Krosan Restorer's threshold untap helps pay the {3}-per-counter cost. Single-card anchor — speculate only with support.
pitch: A 20/20 flying indestructible token, out of nowhere. Crop Rotation fetches Dark Depths and green ramp clears its ice counters for a sudden knockout. A high-risk, high-reward pick for players who love a flashy one-card haymaker.
pitch_es: Una ficha 20/20 voladora e indestructible, salida de la nada. Crop Rotation busca Dark Depths y la aceleración verde limpia sus contadores de hielo para un nocaut repentino. Una elección de alto riesgo y alta recompensa para quienes adoran un mandoble llamativo de una sola carta.
rationale_es: Dark Depths crea una ficha legendaria 20/20 voladora e indestructible en cuanto desaparecen sus diez contadores de hielo; Crop Rotation ("Search your library for a land card, put that card onto the battlefield") la busca, Exploration repone las tierras que se come, y el desgiro por threshold de Krosan Restorer ayuda a pagar el coste de {3} por contador. Ancla de una sola carta: especula solo con apoyo.

keystones: Legacy Weapon; Sol'kanar the Swamp King
core_cards: Rith, the Awakener; Arcades Sabboth; Xira Arien; Gemstone Mine; Birds of Paradise; Crosis's Catacombs; Darigaaz's Caldera; Dromar's Cavern; Rith's Grove; Treva's Ruins; Lotus Blossom; Nature's Lore; Terminal Moraine; Wild Growth
rationale: Five Lair lands, Gemstone Mine, Lotus Blossom, and Birds of Paradise assemble WUBRG for the cube's gold top-end: Legacy Weapon's "{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Exile target permanent" becomes a repeatable removal engine, with Sol'kanar, Rith, Arcades Sabboth, and Xira Arien's card-draw sink as the payoffs the fixing earns.
pitch: Play every splashy gold bomb in the cube, all in one deck. Lair lands, Gemstone Mine and Birds of Paradise make the mana work, and Legacy Weapon becomes a repeatable removal engine. For players who want the greediest pile at the table.
pitch_es: Juega todas las bombas doradas llamativas del cubo, en un solo mazo. Las tierras Lair, Gemstone Mine y Birds of Paradise hacen funcionar el maná, y Legacy Weapon se convierte en un motor de eliminación repetible. Para quienes quieren el montón más codicioso de la mesa.
rationale_es: Cinco tierras Lair, Gemstone Mine, Lotus Blossom y Birds of Paradise ensamblan WUBRG para la gama alta dorada del cubo: el "{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}: Exile target permanent" de Legacy Weapon se convierte en un motor de eliminación repetible, con Sol'kanar, Rith, Arcades Sabboth y el sumidero de robo de Xira Arien como las recompensas que el fijado de maná se gana.

core_cards: Nantuko Shade; Shivan Dragon; Avarax; Dragon Whelp; Glintwing Invoker; Stonewood Invoker; Howl from Beyond; High Tide; Kamahl, Fist of Krosa
rationale: Gauntlet of Power pumps the chosen color and makes every basic of that color "add an additional one mana"; the cube is full of firebreathing-style sinks to spend it — Nantuko Shade and Shivan Dragon pump per mana, Howl from Beyond is an X-spell, and the Invokers carry 7-mana activations.
pitch: Commit to one colour and get paid twice for every land. Gauntlet of Power supercharges your basics until firebreathers like Nantuko Shade and Shivan Dragon grow completely out of control. For players who like going tall rather than wide.
pitch_es: Comprométete con un solo color y cobra el doble por cada tierra. Gauntlet of Power sobrealimenta tus básicas hasta que escupefuegos como Nantuko Shade y Shivan Dragon crecen totalmente fuera de control. Para quienes prefieren crecer a lo alto antes que a lo ancho.
rationale_es: Gauntlet of Power pompea el color elegido y hace que cada básica de ese color "add an additional one mana"; el cubo está lleno de sumideros estilo escupefuego para gastarlo — Nantuko Shade y Shivan Dragon pompean por maná, Howl from Beyond es un hechizo con X, y los Invokers llevan activaciones de 7 manás.
key_themes_es: Sumideros de maná; Pompa por color

rationale: Horseshoe Crab's "{U}: Untap this creature" repeats any tap ability: with Hermetic Study ("{T}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target") every {U} is a ping, with Quicksilver Dagger it is a ping plus a card, and with Opposition every {U} taps an opposing permanent. Two-card engine — draft the pieces together.
pitch: Two cards turn Horseshoe Crab into a machine gun. Hermetic Study makes each untap a ping, Quicksilver Dagger makes it draw a card, and Opposition locks down the board instead. A puzzle-piece build-around for players who love repeatable engines.
pitch_es: Dos cartas convierten a Horseshoe Crab en una ametralladora. Con Hermetic Study cada desgiro es un pinchazo, con Quicksilver Dagger además roba una carta, y con Opposition bloquea el tablero entero. Una pieza de puzle para quienes adoran los motores repetibles.
rationale_es: El "{U}: Untap this creature" de Horseshoe Crab repite cualquier habilidad de giro: con Hermetic Study ("{T}: This creature deals 1 damage to any target") cada {U} es un pinchazo, con Quicksilver Dagger es un pinchazo más una carta, y con Opposition cada {U} gira un permanente rival. Motor de dos cartas: draftea las piezas juntas.
